gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-cham: Spaced out and quietly lavish, Stentiga draws every join as sturdy as its stems. Noto Sans Cham follows with rounded, tall lowercase and generous c openings, a modern sans-serif that keeps the display lettering company without crowding it.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-cheroke: Stentiga spreads its letters wide and draws each stroke as one uninterrupted line, giving the heading a refined, luxurious feel. Make it large, and let the body stay modest.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-chorasm: Stentiga strides across the top with wide-open spacing and no brush-like swell anywhere in its lines. Noto Sans Chorasmian sits below as a contemporary sans-serif, with a large x-height and curves that stop short instead of closing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic reads with a dominant middle zone and uncrowded mouths on its s and c. Stentiga's uppercase, built from lines of one constant thickness and spaced luxuriously, then sits above it like a gilded header.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-cuneifo: Refined, with a lavish, spread-out stance. Noto Sans Cuneiform below has a lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads and an e that opens up, so a long stretch of text feels soft and easygoing next to Stentiga's thin-free joins.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret is approachable and clean, with open apertures and a wide-looking lowercase topped by squat ascenders. Stentiga is the one for luxurious display; this sans does the quiet reading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-devanag: Luxurious, thanks to Stentiga's wide tracking and strokes drawn at one thickness. Noto Sans Devanagari is a modern plain sans with a compact skyline, so give it a little extra size and let it hold its own beneath the heading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-duploya: Noto Sans Duployan opens its lowercase a wide and gives its e and a oversized counters. And Stentiga's plain, unshaded line that never swells makes that generosity feel deliberate, a refined heading with a gentle contemporary partner.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan has large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance, and its open terminals never pinch shut. Stentiga's hairlines never appear, so both fonts feel sturdy.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, its apertures open throughout and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Stentiga brings a luxurious single-width stroke to display; the sans-serif simply carries the text.
